title: Kim and the Little Round Window
synopsis: Kim visits Sue to admire the round window; three familiar pebbles become imaginary mountains and a quiet humming tune finds its ending.
continuity_state: Before: The castle bakery sits beside Sue's round window. Sue still owns the yellow-star cushion, and Kim keeps exactly three pebbles in her violet pouch, including the striped gray one. After: Kim and Sue meet at Round Window Cottage. With permission, Kim temporarily arranges three pebbles on a cloth as pretend mountains, then returns all three to her violet pouch. Sue keeps her cushion; the castle bakery stays inside the cottage. Kim and Sue discover a shared taste for a soft song ending. Kim goes home near Round Pond with her grown-up.
